# Amazon Transcribe

Create local S3 transcription job output exclusively from registered URI/language fixtures.

**Status: implemented subset.** Operation selection does not imply complete input or behavior parity.

| Contract | Current implementation |
| --- | --- |
| Service ID | `transcribe` |
| Signing name | `transcribe` |
| Wire protocol | AWS JSON 1.1 |
| API version | `2017-10-26` |
| Scope | Account and region |
| Execution | Fixture-backed local S3 transcript writes; no speech inference |
| Selected operations | 17 of 44 in the pinned model |

## Implemented behavior

See the [implemented feature catalogue](catalogue.md#amazon-transcribe) for this service's capabilities.

## Limitations and future work

- No speech recognition, fabricated transcripts, word items, timings or confidence values.
- Vocabulary/filter contents do not alter fixture transcripts; DownloadUri is omitted instead of inventing a download URL.
- Language identification, redaction, subtitles, speaker/channel settings, toxicity detection, custom models and service-managed output buckets fail explicitly.
- No medical, medical scribe, call analytics, language models or HTTP/2 streaming operations.
- Optional vocabulary/filter DataAccessRoleArn and encryption configuration inputs are not whitelisted; generated rejection avoids accepting unsupported execution.
- The current CloudFormation specification includes Transcribe types, contrary to the task note; transcription jobs via CloudFormation are unsupported because its schema has no customer output bucket.
- S3 object writes and job record completion are not atomic; partial output may remain after interruption.

These gaps describe current boundaries and possible follow-up slices. The [roadmap](../roadmap/index.md)
separates proposed work from registered functionality; there are no promised release dates.
